background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: As the holding company its ratings sit below the operating bank's, at AA- from Fitch, A- from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable, with the last move Moody's upgrade to A1 on 3 May 2023. Consolidated capital is on the weak side against US peers: CET1 of 11.2% is in the bottom quarter against the peer median and leverage of 5.5% is below the peer median. LCR of 112% also sits below the peer median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The one flagged item, on 9 Sep 2026, is not credit-relevant.
